text:
emily (PM): thanks for joining Q&A. quick ask: we need a compact rollout sequence for API -> Console -> Optimize to publish to partners. can we lock owners and rough windows?

marc (CEO): short answer: API first, Console after API is stable, Optimize beta overlapping Console finalization. owners: API: tess, Console: alvin, Optimize: emily.

tess (Eng): API plan: canary 24h @2% traffic, expand to 15% after checks, then 7-day stability before GA. smoke tests run automatically. deploy snippet: `./deploy --svc api --ver 2.4.0 --canary --pct 2`

alvin (DevEx): Console needs a UI flag for dedicated autoscale and an endpoint to fetch pool sizes. ETA for UI work: 9 days after API GA. will sync with infra.

sora (Security): security checklist: telemetry docs + opt-out for Private. I'll target completion before Console canary. Private deployments default telemetry = off.

ci-bot: Canary created: api-service v2.4.0 -> 2% -> 2024-09-12T16:00:00Z

emily (PM): action items: tess files canary ticket, alvin files Console feature-parity checklist, sora posts security checklist link. I'll draft the partner note once we have canary start time confirmed.

marc (CEO): keep canaries small and staggered. thanks everyone.

alvin (DevEx): will prepare SDK doc blurb and a 30-min "what's changing" session in the week after API GA.

emily (PM): great, will follow up here with links and calendar invites.
